title: Inactive Signups
scenario: Find all 'user_id' who signed up but have not performed any action (confirmed or timeout). Return the result table as 'user_id'.
tableSchema: signups (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME), confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR)
hint: Use NOT IN with a subquery of user_ids found in the confirmations table.
correctQuery: SELECT user_id FROM signups WHERE user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM confirmations);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE signups (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME); CREATE TABLE confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR); INSERT INTO signups VALUES (6, '2020-12-09 10:39:37');
